comments.text: The process servers testified that children pulled the papers off doors, so they had been told to tape them up high. The tenants say they learned about the case when the writ of possession arrived -- after the judgment and after the appeal window had closed. If a notice about you was taped to your door today and it blew off, would you have any way of knowing it had been there?

She was handed number 47 and waited around two hours with chest pains. No physician saw her, no vital signs were taken, and at trial the hospital could not produce a single record that she had been there at all. What is the longest you have waited in an emergency room before anyone measured anything?

One house, one family, and two accounts -- because a second bill came addressed to Willie C. Craft instead of Willie S. Craft. The power was cut five times over it. Has a utility or a bank ever opened a second account in your name off a typo? I want to know how often that actually happens.

The arbitration clause sent every dispute to a private arbitrator, with one exception written into the same sentence: claims to collect late payments owed by the patient. Those stayed in court. If you have ever signed an admission agreement for a parent, did anyone read that paragraph out to you?
